title.from: An idea starts from one real story and invents the angle
title.to: An idea starts from a real event or is wholly invented

description.from:
Every idea path today joins at least two sources and refuses invention.

```gherkin
Feature: Premise-led ideas

  Scenario: One real event, one invented angle
    Given an accepted Reference about a real event
    When satire ideas are generated
    Then each idea names the real event it comes from
    And states its invented premise separately

  Scenario: The source is not copied
    Given an idea from a Reference
    When the piece is drafted
    Then it reuses none of the source's sentences
```
description.to:
Satire may start from a real event or be made up whole (Ryan, 2026-11-15). Every idea path today joins at least two sources and refuses invention.

```gherkin
Feature: Premise-led ideas

  Scenario: One real event, one invented angle
    Given an accepted Reference about a real event
    When satire ideas are generated
    Then each idea names the real event it comes from
    And states its invented premise separately

  Scenario: A wholly invented premise
    Given no Reference
    When satire ideas are generated
    Then an idea may carry an invented premise with no real event behind it
    And it is not rejected for lacking a source

  Scenario: The source is not copied
    Given an idea from a Reference
    When the piece is drafted
    Then it reuses none of the source's sentences
```
